note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: Push-Location src\EquipmentSync; dotnet build -nologo -v q; Pop-Location
# owner signs in: interactive OAuth prompt of the maker account (MG_OAUTH_APPID is the public client id the owner set)
Push-Location src\EquipmentSync; dotnet run --no-build -- setup --enable-change-tracking; Pop-Location

Read-Host 'Owner: the Entra app registration for the nightly job, its client secret (short expiry), the application user in DEV with the custom role Equipment Sync (Create/Write on Equipment, organization-level Read) exist; MG_SYNC_APPID and MG_SYNC_APPSECRET are set. Press Enter'

screens.name: alternate-key
steps: Show 'Asset tag key' on the column Asset tag with status Active
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
application (client) id and any key logical name tied to the tenant

screens.name: import-run
prepare: Read-Host 'Owner: in the Equipment Desk phone app (episode 2) lend CT-0043 so its status is On loan. Press Enter'
steps: After the terminal part: open the model-driven app Equipment Desk > Equipment
Show CT-0512 'Laptop 16, docked', CT-0513, CT-0514 Available, CT-0311 In repair, CT-0400 Retired and CT-0043 still On loan
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
the connection string and any app id (never in the terminal output)

screens.name: export-changes
prepare: Push-Location src\EquipmentSync; dotnet run --no-build -- export ./state.json ./changes.csv; Pop-Location
Read-Host 'Owner: in the model-driven app set CT-0043 back to Available, then lend CT-0107 in the phone app. Press Enter'

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: delete the client secret / app registration and the application user in DEV; delete CT-0512..CT-0514 or keep them; set CT-0043 and CT-0107 back to Available. The alternate key stays; change tracking cannot be turned off.'
